c: A composite is a named edit that people and agents actually ask for — "draw a wall from here to there", "make the kitchen two feet wider", "put a door in the middle of that wall". Each is defined here as the exact sequence of primitives it expands to, so that every applier makes the same edit. A composite's references are resolved against the working copy before it (
